summary: This release PR bumps the desktop version to 0.1.71, pins the control-plane and workspace-server images to 0.1.71, and adds releases/0.1.71.json. The manifest's protocols match the source: haloProtocolVersion 27, supported [25, 26, 27], and control plane 5, supported [3, 5]. The minimumFrontendVersion 0.1.68 carries forward from 0.1.70 and needs protocol 25, which is still supported. No other 0.1.70 references remain outside releases/, and there are no executable changes that need tests.
